I estimate each piece at roughly 8x6 cm and about 1 cm thick, which is 40-50 g. Three pieces come to about 135 g.

Cheese pizza runs about 2.7 kcal/g, so 135 g is roughly 365 kcal. The pieces look thin and the cheese is sparse, so I'm lowering that to about 330 kcal.
